desc: The best deal for the 1st time buyer. This is our original target kit. Tannerite® is non-hazardous and can be shipped without expensive hazmat fees. The catalyst mixes easily into each 1/2 pound target. A free instructional dvd is provided with every order which shows the legalities and requirements regarding the possession and use of this awesome product. We ship direct to your door and it's legal in all states.
